podcast.body: A single from the Evil Empire album that highlighted the internal difficulties within the band due to their political stances. The track is about the Zapatista Revolution in the Mexican state of Chiapas, led by Subcomandante Marcos, who were Libertarian Marxists and declared war on the Mexican government in 1994. Rage Against the Machine met with Subcomandante Marcos in the Mayan jungle, embracing the Zapatistas while elements of the media labeled them as terrorists, and the band simultaneously called out American politicians and military figures as war criminals. "This track is about the Zapatista Revolution, which was going on at the time in the Mexican state of Chiapas, one of the poorest in the country."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
